diagnosis: TriggerWebhookTestView allows triggering test webhook dispatches while throttling by webhook_id. Because get_cache_key() computes the cache key solely from view.kwargs.get('webhook_id') and the view does not verify that request.user owns the target WebhookSubscription, an authenticated attacker can spam test requests against another company's webhook ID, locking their webhook dispatch channel due to throttle saturation.
exploit_request:
POST /api/webhooks/710/test/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.hookbridge.net
Authorization: Bearer 12a3b4c5...
Accept: application/json
